notes:
Both retrieved full-text titles and DOIs verified against supplied references. Target ambiguity retained: the input does not specify boundary, target region or frequency condition, so target_match is null. Main n+2/low-frequency target selected from the stated replication of Yang et al. (2012); no n+1 and n+2 statistics are combined. Original p. 1088 also prints b = 17, SE = 8.4, p < .05 for the DIFFERENT boundary-after-n−1 (n+1 preview) test; those coefficients must not be assigned to the n+2 test. Original n+2 coefficient not printed. Original table extraction renders > as [ and < as backslash. Replication Table 3 prints b/SE/t without p values; no p computed. Its lower-frequency section header reads "Word n+2 Low Frequency", but Methods/Results and Table 2 establish that the manipulated frequency is word n+1. Replication accepted-manuscript pagination differs from the supplied p. 9 locator.
Completion source review (n_r): Two explicitly final, mutually exclusive participant groups; source specifies all participants received all conditions. Participant N established independently of trial exclusions; exact retained observation N unreported.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Table 3 explicitly reports b = -0.02 and t = -0.59 for single fixation duration (SFD) in the low-frequency Word n+2 preview model. Outcome/reference-based mapping documented in checkpoint notes; no effect-size conversion.
